title: LLaDA2.0-Uni: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation
summary: A unified discrete diffusion large language model that natively performs both image understanding and high-fidelity generation. It utilizes a 16B Mixture-of-Experts backbone to handle interleaved multimodal reasoning without external generation modules.
research_notes: Developed by Inclusion AI (Ant Group); uses a unique SigLIP-VQ tokenizer and a diffusion-based 'Thinking Mode' for spatial reasoning.

evolution.summary: Evolved from the text-only LLaDA 1.0 and LLaDA 2.0-Flash; added ComfyUI support on May 12, 2026. An FP8 quantized version was released in May 2026 to optimize VRAM usage for consumer GPUs.
